description: Gets a B2B SaaS vendor's Shopify app approved, ranked and kept on the Shopify App Store - locked public vs custom distribution, Shopify billing for an already-billing SaaS, protected customer data, submission packet, review rounds and Paused cooldowns, Built for Shopify, ranking, review requests, quality checks.
